description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the Mqtt5Validator class within the Eclipse Ditto project. The tests validate various aspects of MQTT v5 connection configurations, including address validation, immutability, protocol security, and enforcement rules. It utilizes JUnit, AssertJ, and Akka TestKit for testing, and references several internal classes and constants specific to the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: Mqtt5ValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the Mqtt5Validator's configuration validation logic within the Eclipse Ditto MQTT connectivity module.

methods.description: Initializes the Akka ActorSystem before running tests.
